live.title: India Disaster Intelligence
live.subtitle: Official warnings, current observations and local context — with clear sources.
live.privacy: Use your location once to find relevant weather, warnings and nearby facilities. It stays in this session unless you explicitly save it.
live.search: Search an Indian city or location
live.districtUnavailable: District list unavailable. Search your district or choose a point on the map.
live.searchEmpty: No matching location found. Try a nearby city or select a point on the map.
live.locationError: Location could not be obtained. Search manually or choose a point on the map.
live.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. You can continue with search or map selection.
live.searchError: Location search is temporarily unavailable. You can still select a point on the map.
live.saveLogin: Sign in to save a location securely.
live.saveError: The location could not be saved. Please try again.
live.selectForSafety: Choose a location to assess available local signals.
live.notGuarantee: A data-based indication, not a guarantee of safety. Follow local authorities.
live.noAlerts: No relevant active official alerts returned by the feed.
live.officialUnavailable: Official alert feed unavailable. The absence of data does not mean your area is safe.
live.mapHint: Click the map to select a location. Only geographically verified items are mapped.
live.layerNoGeometry: No verified geometry available for this layer at this location.
live.boundaryError: Boundaries unavailable. The base map remains usable.
live.chooseWeather: Choose a location to see weather.
live.noEarthquakes: No earthquakes returned for the selected region and period.
live.safetyUnknown: Safety and availability unverified; confirm with local authorities before travelling.
live.noFacilities: No facilities returned nearby. This does not mean none exist.
live.facilitiesUnavailable: Nearby facilities could not be retrieved.
live.newsDescription: News reports are context, not confirmed emergencies or official evacuation advice.
live.newsNoDistance: Precise location unavailable; distance is not estimated.
live.noNews: No recent reports matched this selection.
live.newsStateScope: Reports are searched by place name. Radius filtering only applies when a report has verified coordinates.
live.riskUnavailable: Insufficient reliable data to calculate a local indicator.
live.planningNote: The original habitation assessment, risk charts, site matching and relocation simulation remain available in a clearly labelled demonstration workspace.
live.groundwaterNote: Historical groundwater observations provide environmental context; they are not live flood or landslide warnings.
live.aiDisclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Follow official instructions. Immediate danger? Call 112.
live.aiWelcome: Ask about alerts, weather and practical disaster safety. I use available application data and identify missing information.
live.aiPlaceholder: Ask in English, हिन्दी or Hinglish…
live.aiError: The assistant is unavailable. Please try again. In immediate danger, call 112.
live.actionPrompt: What should I do during a flood?
live.emergencyText: You are about to call India's emergency response number 112. Use this for genuine emergencies requiring police, fire, medical or disaster assistance.
live.floodAction: Flood: move to higher ground, avoid flowing water and follow official evacuation instructions.
live.landslideAction: Landslide: move away from the slope or debris path and follow authority instructions.
live.notifyBlocked: Notifications are blocked in browser settings.
live.notifyUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
live.notifyExplanation: While this app is open, notify only for relevant serious official alerts, using your chosen hazard types and radius.
live.networkError: Some data could not be loaded. Retry or check the official source.
live.riskNote: The indicator summarizes available signals. It is not an official warning or a prediction of a disaster.
live.noLocalSignals: No local signal has been verified yet.
live.regionalAlerts: Regional alerts may cover a district or state; they are not precise incident points.
live.historicalBoundary: Historical administrative boundaries; not authoritative current jurisdiction
live.aiNotConfigured: Suraksha AI is not connected yet. Please follow official sources; for an emergency, call 112.
live.aiRateLimit: Too many messages. Please wait a minute and try again.
live.facilitiesDescription: Find reported facilities around your selected location anywhere in India.
live.planningLimits: These candidates are ordered by straight-line distance, not verified safety. Shelter designation, available capacity, accessible road routes and current conditions require local confirmation before any move. No people are allocated to unverified facilities.
live.alertCoverage: Coverage is limited to the latest public feed and a bounded set of CAP documents. Only warnings with confirmed active periods appear here. An empty list does not rule out an alert; check SACHET and local authorities.
